symbol_repair_2026_11_08.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v15mu.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F06D μ, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.what_changed: One Greek small mu (Symbol F06D -> μ, the micro prefix) restored at line 7907, the note to clause 7(1) of Schedule B (Basin Salinity Management) to the Murray-Darling Basin Agreement in Schedule 1: "Note: E.C. stands for Electrical Conductivity, measured in S/cm." is now "Note: E.C. stands for Electrical Conductivity, measured in μS/cm." Without the μ the unit read as siemens per centimetre, a factor of 10^6 out, so the 800 E.C. Basin Salinity Target was stated in the wrong unit. A diff against the first deposit shows no other change; same 11,398 lines, one character more. Line numbers are unchanged, so the formulas sidecar's line references still hold.
